newsitem.title: UK: GKN says current profits ahead despite stg.
newsitem.headline: GKN says current profits ahead despite stg.

text.p: British engineering giant GKN Plc said on Thursday that pre-tax profits in the first four months of the year were ahead of the same period a year ago despite the adverse impact of a strong pound.
The company told shareholders at its annual meeting that the strength of the pound had had an adverse currency translation impact of more than 10 million stg.
"Performance in the first four months of the year has been positive in all our main businesses," said chairman David Lees.
GKN predicted in March that the strength of the pound might take a minimum 18 million stg off operating profits this year.
The company made pre-tax profits before exceptionals of 362.8 million stg in 1996.
